en: From the start of battle, unleashes chain lightning at each of the [[frontmost]] and [[rearmost]] enemies every [[6]]s, dealing magic damage equal to [[65%]] of [[Team ATK]]. The lightning then bounces to the nearest enemy [[3]] times, with its damage reduced by [[20%]] after each bounce.
